title: The Magic of Turmeric
author: Team Heritage
content: Turmeric is a bright yellow powder. In many Indian homes, people call it 'Haldi'. Long ago, our grandparents used turmeric not just for food, but also as medicine. If someone had a small cut, they put turmeric on it. If you had a cold, they gave you warm turmeric milk. Turmeric helps your body fight germs, keeps your skin healthy, and even helps your tummy feel better. So next time you see that yellow powder, remember it's not just for taste, it's for good health too!

title: What is Garam Masala?
author: Team Heritage
content: Garam Masala is a special mix of spices used in Indian cooking. It is made by mixing things like cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, and pepper. These spices are first roasted, then ground into powder. People add garam masala to curries and dals to make them taste strong and yummy. It makes the food warm and tasty. Even a little bit can change the flavor a lot. Think of it like a magic powder for food!

title: Spices That Help You Stay Healthy
author: Team Heritage
content: Spices are not just for taste. Some spices help your body feel strong and fresh. Turmeric keeps you safe from sickness. Ginger helps when you have a cough or cold. Cumin makes your stomach happy. Black pepper helps you breathe better. Our parents and grandparents use these spices every day in food to keep us healthy without using medicine. So, eating food with spices is like giving your body a small shield every day!
